data.title: ORB Tower at District One
data.about:
Waterfront Lifestyle That Is A Class Apart. Located within one of the most sought-after gated communities in MBR City, District One’s Orb Tower, is the epitome of luxury living offering unparalleled roof-top facilities and beautiful apartments As a resident of Orb Tower, you will live the most idyllic waterfront lifestyle surrounded by the beauty and calmness of nature. 

Choose from aesthetically crafted 1 – 4 bedroom apartments with mesmerising views of District One’s 60% green coverage, these homes are located just minutes from Downtown Dubai.

characteristics_module.title: No Service Charge Fee for 2 Years
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• No Land Registration Fee
  • Pay 60% during construction and 40% on handover
  • 1 BR starting at AED 1.5 million
  • Limited Units Available

location_tile.title: Ideally Located Amidst Nature
location_tile.description:
Located in MBR City, ORB Tower, is just 10 minutes from Downtown Dubai. MBR City, or Mohamed Bin Rashid Al Maktoum City, is the only project with the Dubai’s royal name on it, and is a visionary self-sufficient city within a city project. You can access District One easily via Al Khail Road. Residents of Orb Tower will have easy access to Meydan Racecourse, Grandstand, The Track, Meydan Golf, 9-hole floodlit golf course, 2 international schools, 5-star luxury Meydan Hotel, Meydan One Mall and more

  • 02 mins – Meydan One
  • 05 mins – Meydan Hotel
  • 12 mins – DIFC
  • 15 mins – Burj Al Arab
  • 16 mins – World Trade Centre
  • 20 mins – Dubai International Airport
